limits: The temporary address makes this one destination IP local for all ports and protocols; only TCP 7000 is serviced.
No login, account, GameGuard, other-service or gameplay compatibility is tested.
ReplyWritten means the local probe handed the acknowledgement to its socket; it does not prove application-level acceptance.
Closing or killing this window abruptly may leave the volatile address until CleanupLocalHandshake.cmd or a reboot.

established: Software-loopback address, route, synthetic local connection and listener readiness verified.
The actual rumblefighter process with the pinned executable hash established a TCP connection to the local probe.
Cleanup stopped the listener and verified that the temporary address and route were absent.
not_established: A complete version header was not recorded.
The first-run root cause is still not conclusively identified, although revised setup succeeded.
Application protocol compatibility, login, gameplay and fully offline operation are not validated.
report_limit: In version 1.1 request_bytes is set only after a complete six-byte header is read. Zero therefore cannot exclude 1-5 partial bytes. io_or_read_deadline conflates timeout, EOF/reset and other IO.
inference: Version frames immediately precede login attempts in the original capture. A Sign In trigger is plausible but not proven because no UI events were recorded.
next_test: Keep the same verified local route and exact-build checks; allow a bounded 120-second overall window, wait for first bytes before starting the 5-second frame-completion deadline, and request one Sign In with invented values only after local peer verification.
data_limits: The probe reads at most 26 bytes, handles only the opening version request, writes at most six acknowledgement bytes, then closes. No login body is read or stored.
